title: zephyranthes tubispatha
intro: Zephyranthes tubispatha, commonly known as the Windmill Lily or Zephyr Lily, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaryllidaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Zephyranthes tubispatha include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
